summary: Brera Holdings PLC, now operating as Solmate Infrastructure (NASDAQ: SLMT), furnished a Form 6-K on September 24, 2026, announcing the appointment of Yaffa Cohen-Ifrah as Chief Marketing Officer and Head of Investor Relations, based in New York. The press release also disclosed the estimated market value of the company's Solana treasury. The filing is a routine current report covering an ordinary executive appointment and business update, not a special situation; no transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are involved.
